crossRefs.note: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.
Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

translations.web: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
translations.bsb: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.
translations.kjv: Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer
translations.asv: Hear, O Jehovah, when I cry with my voice: Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
